novelty.justification: The claim proposes a measurement-level unification: “a single mechanistic quantity—belief-assertion divergence” should detect “deception, sycophancy, sandbagging, and confabulation” with a shared belief probe. Searches for “LLM belief output disagreement probe deception sycophancy sandbagging hallucination,” “latent knowledge output divergence oversight,” and “activation probe untruthful output” identify Burns et al. (2023), Azaria and Mitchell (2023), and especially Eliciting Latent Knowledge from Quirky Language Models (2023), which already probes knowledge independently of model outputs and uses activation-based anomaly detection to flag untruthful behavior. Extending that latent-knowledge-versus-output template across four named failure suites is a natural, somewhat broader operationalization rather than a new core mechanism; no purpose-built relationship beyond applying the same standard disagreement signal to additional behaviors is specified.
